description:
Compare 2-5 named apps side by side on grounded facts: pricing (each vendor's own currency and plans), free tier / trial / open-source / self-hosting status, and features — including which features they share and which are unique to each.

Use when the user weighs specific apps against each other ("Notion vs Coda", "which of these is cheapest"). Facts come from each product's own website; unstated fields are marked "not stated", never guessed. Apps not in the catalog are excluded and named — their absence from appclap is not evidence about them. Optional focus narrows the comparison (e.g. "pricing", "features").

Results carry a link on each app's name. Present them as links rather than plain names — that link is how the reader reaches the product, and it resolves to the vendor's own site.

focus.description: Optional aspect to focus on, e.g. 'pricing' or 'features'.
